subject: science
skillName: Fossils Give Evidence of the Past

items.prompt:
A fossil is
A) a living animal
B) the preserved remains or traces of a living thing from long ago
C) a type of cloud
D) a fresh leaf
items.answer: B) the preserved remains or traces of a living thing from long ago

steps: Fossils are preserved remains or traces of past life.

items.prompt:
A seashell fossil on a dry mountain suggests the area once had
A) water
B) fire
C) no life
D) ice only

Can fossils tell us about past environments?
A) Yes
B) No
C) Only about colors
D) Only about today

steps: Fossils give clues about past environments.

items.prompt:
A very large footprint fossil suggests the animal was
A) tiny
B) large
C) invisible
D) a plant

steps: A large footprint means a large animal.

items.prompt:
Fern fossils that need wet, warm places suggest the area was once
A) a dry desert
B) wet and warm
C) frozen
D) on the Moon

steps: Those plants grow in wet, warm places.

items.prompt:
A leaf imprint fossil is evidence that a ____ lived there.
A) fish
B) plant
C) rock
D) cloud

steps: A leaf imprint comes from a plant.

items.prompt:
A fish fossil found in a desert is evidence that the desert
A) was always dry
B) was once covered by water
C) never had life
D) is on fire
items.answer: B) was once covered by water

steps: Fish live in water, so water was once there.

items.prompt:
A tropical plant fossil found in a now-cold place suggests the area was once
A) colder
B) warm enough for tropical plants
C) on the Moon
D) underwater only
items.answer: B) warm enough for tropical plants

steps: Tropical plant fossils suggest a once-warm environment.
